prompt:
DESKTOP LANDING PAGE COMP 3 of 3, "THE PRODUCT": a luxury brand website, first viewport, with the headline layered BEHIND the product.
LAYOUT:
1. Top bar as specified.
2. Behind everything, spanning the full page width across the vertical middle, the headline DISCIPLINE, MADE DAILY. in colossal ultra-thin extended warm-white capitals, so large it nearly touches both page edges, at about 22% opacity so it reads as an engraved backdrop.
3. In front of the headline, dead center, a single black titanium iPhone standing upright, seen straight-on with a very slight three-quarter turn, resting on a black mirror floor with a crisp reflection. Its screen shows the SECOND reference image (the real app's home screen: dark plum ground, gold LOCK IN button) faithfully and legibly. One narrow soft beam of warm light falls on the phone from above. The phone is about 70% of viewport height.
4. Left of the phone, lower third, small warm-grey text block of three lines, left-aligned: "One check-in a day." / "Status you earn, never buy." / "Coach, training, fuel and the Vault in one app."
5. Right of the phone, lower third, right-aligned: COMING TO THE APP STORE in small tracked gold capitals on a gold hairline.
6. Bottom edge of viewport, full-width thin gold hairline and beneath it in tiny tracked warm-grey capitals: "WHEALTH FACTORY CORPORATION FINLAND OY  ·  BUSINESS ID 3636449-8  ·  ESPOO" on the left and "SCROLL" on the right.
The focal move is the phone; the giant headline is a quiet backdrop, never competing.
WORLD (identical in every comp): a luxury manufacture's website. Pure black ground (#050505) edge to edge. ONE metal only: polished gold, exactly the gold of the reference W logo image (warm yellow gold with bright specular highlights and deep amber shadows), used only on the W and on hairline rules. Text in warm white (#EDE8DF) and a dimmer warm grey for small labels. Display type: huge, ultra-thin (hairline weight) EXTENDED sans-serif capitals, very wide letterforms, generous letter-spacing, in the manner of a Swiss watch maison or a haute couture house. Small labels: tiny tracked uppercase sans with tabular figures. Crisp, razor-sharp, vector-clean: NO film grain, NO noise, NO blur, NO bokeh, NO smoke, NO lens flare, NO gradients except the gold metal's own reflections. No cards, no boxes, no rounded buttons, no icons, no stock photos, no people. Vast negative space. Slow, confident, expensive.
REFERENCE IMAGE: the gold W is the brand mark and must appear as this exact W letterform (two V's joined, beveled polished gold). Take only the W's shape and gold material from it; do not copy its black square tile or its star glint layout.
TOP BAR (thin, same in every comp): far left a small gold W mark followed by the wordmark WHEALTH FACTORY in small widely tracked warm-white capitals; far right the small label MANUFACTURE · ESPOO, FINLAND. Nothing else in the bar: NO navigation links, NO menu icon, NO sign-in, NO buttons.
The action is not a button: it is the words COMING TO THE APP STORE in small tracked gold capitals sitting on a single thin gold hairline rule, no box, no Apple logo.
Render as a flat, full-bleed desktop website screenshot at 1536x1024, straight-on, no browser chrome, no device frame, no perspective tilt of the page itself.
